transcription.text: We might provisionally, though perhaps not quite correctly, define memory as that way of knowing about the past which has no analog in our knowledge of the future. Such a definition would at least serve to mark the problem with which we are concerned, though some expectations may deserve to rank with memory as regards immediacy.
